title: n8n Custom Node Development
summary: This day covers essential concepts for building AI engineering skills.
topics: Building actions, triggers, and loading options
practical_task_reference: Scaffold a custom n8n node from the starter, implement a declarative node for a public API with one credential type and two operations (e.g., get and create), run it in a local n8n, and use it in a workflow.
mini_project_reference: Build, test, and package (as an installable npm/community node) a custom n8n node for an API of your choice with a credentials type, multiple operations, a loadOptions dynamic dropdown, and clean error handling.
assignment_reference: Compare declarative and programmatic n8n node styles, explaining when to use each, and describe how the credentials type keeps authentication secure and reusable.
